chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Qunut is in every Salat, in the second Rak'at, before the Ruku'.
ai.seo_question: When and where is the Qunut performed in Islamic prayers according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Zurarah to Imam al-Baqir (AS), establishes the permissibility and common practice of performing Qunut in the second Rak'ah before Ruku' for all obligatory prayers. While some schools restrict Qunut to Fajr or specific occasions, this hadith reflects the Shia view that it is a recommended act (Mustahabb) in every prayer, emphasizing the believer's constant connection with God through supplication. The placement before Ruku' highlights its role as a direct appeal to Allah before entering the posture of humility.
